snippet.title: Realindustry — The System (v1.0.0) | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Steel is not iron plus heat. Automation is not a button.

Realindustry is a hyper-realistic industrial simulation where every material, formula, and production step follows real industrial logic. Understand each process, then design the system that runs it.

Assign colonists. Build loops. Branch on stock levels. Install automation cores. Grow one interconnected industry from wood and stone to semiconductors, nuclear power, quantum engineering, and antimatter.

Version 1.0.0 features:
• 236 materials
• 353 production processes
• 56 industrial facilities
• 146 interconnected research projects across 10 technology tiers

Your assignment is simple: produce one Hyperdrive Engine.
Before you complete it, ask who benefits.

Realindustry launches on Steam on September 22, 2026.

Wishlist the full game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4384850/Realindustry/

Play the FREE Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4525260/Realindustry_Demo

https://realindustrygame.com/
